body:
**What changed**
- **Same file names as an installed mod:** some mods use the same file names, such as two styles of one outfit, and the second one used to replace the first as an update. The install window now asks: update the installed mod, or keep both.
- **Keep both:** the new mod goes in a folder of its own in `~mods`, and each mod has its own switch. Both mods may still change the same things in the game. Then only one style or version shows, and the window says so. Only the mod's author can make both work together, with one combined mod.
- **Donate button:** it is above the Discord button and opens a short thank-you window. A donation is fully optional, and every feature works the same without one. The X on the button removes it for good, and the About page keeps it.

**Install:** unzip `uemm_phantom-blade-zero_1.5.8.zip` into a folder you can write to, for example `Documents\UE MM`, and start `UEModManager.exe`. It needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

**Update from an older version:** the app offers the update at start; one click installs it. Or replace `UEModManager.exe` with the new one. The `Data` folder stays.

**Something does not work?** In the app, open Settings ▸ Report a problem, copy the report and open an [issue](https://github.com/KintaroModding/uemodmanager/issues) with it.
